channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Politics hurting World cricket, IPL the only winner if boycotts continue: Lalit Modi on India–Pak T20 World Cup row
item.description: Former Indian Premier League (IPL) chairman Lalit Modi has criticised Pakistan’s decision to boycott its group-stage fixture against India in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, saying the spirit of cricket is diminished when politics influences sporting participation.

item.title: Rani Mukerji highlights Yash Chopra’s legacy, says Aditya Chopra carries forward fathers’ vision
item.description: Bollywood star Rani Mukerji has opened up about the influence of legendary filmmaker Yash Chopra, saying that his son, Aditya Chopra, continues to uphold his father’s cinematic values and storytelling sensibilities.

item.title: ‘One of the most dangerous teams’: Dhoni on India’s T20 WC squad
item.description: Former India captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni expressed confidence in the Indian team's prospects for the Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, highlighting that they possess the right combination of experience, skill, and balance to perform well in a high-pressure tournament.

item.title: Hyundai Motor, Kia post record Jan sales in US on SUV, hybrid demand
item.description: Hyundai Motor and Kia reported record vehicle sales for January in the United States, driven by strong demand for sport utility vehicles (SUVs) and hybrid models, the automakers said on Wednesday.

item.title: Visakhapatnam Steel Plant back on path of profitability, says CMD
item.description: Public sector enterprise Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is back on the path to profitability with the support of the Central and Andhra Pradesh governments, officials informed Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on Tuesday.

item.title: Sudan, South Sudan violence forces hundreds of thousands to flee: UN
item.description: Hostilities in Sudan and South Sudan have displaced hundreds of thousands of people, UN humanitarians said.

item.title: Randeep Hooda bulks up for ‘Eetha’ with Shraddha Kapoor
item.description: Actor Randeep Hooda has raised the bar for fitness as he shared a mirror selfie showcasing his visibly bulked-up physique for his upcoming film “Eetha” starring Shraddha Kapoor.

item.title: US rallies highlight violence against Hindus in Bangladesh
item.description: Peaceful awareness rallies were held across 25 cities in the United States over the past few days despite severe winter conditions, drawing attention to the violence faced by Hindu and other minority communities in Bangladesh.

item.title: Rajasthan: ED arrests ex-MLA Baljeet Yadav in Rs 3.72 crore MLA fund misuse case
item.description: Yadav was taken into custody late Tuesday night near the Shahjahanpur toll plaza on the Delhi–Jaipur highway and was formally arrested by the Jaipur regional unit of the ED after prolonged overnight questioning.

item.title: Terrorists spotted near cave in Udhampur forest in J&K, security forces move in
item.description: An anti-terrorist operation continued on Wednesday in Jammu and Kashmir’s Udhampur district after the terrorists were spotted firing from a cave.
